op[ billing service

The billing service in a hospital context primarily involves the OP (Outpatient) service billing module, which serves as a centralized point for charging all outpatient services. This module facilitates various billing activities through the 'Service Billing Advanced' screen, where mandatory fields must be filled to process billing effectively. For patients with insurance, verifying eligibility is a crucial step, as it is mandatory before proceeding with billing. The system allows for generating printouts of both service and deduct bills, ensuring that all billing details are accurately documented and accessible. ![Billing Service](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_112817.png)

how to access op billing service?

To access the OP billing service, you need to navigate to the 'OP Billing/Service Billing Advanced' section of the hospital's billing system. This module serves as a centralized point for managing all outpatient (OP) services and billing activities. Once in this section, you can perform various billing processes related to outpatient services provided by the hospital. ![OP Billing Service](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_112817.png)

patient discount

Patients can receive various types of discounts during the billing process. Discounts can be categorized as user-wise limit discounts and date-wise discounts. Billing users who have the privilege to apply discounts can do so on the billing screen, adhering to the limits specified for their user role. Additionally, if a date-wise discount is applicable for a patient, it can be applied against any service. To apply a discount profile to a patient's bill, the user must select the relevant details from the 'Reference' field and click the 'Apply' button, which will automatically apply the discount to the bill. ![Patient Discount](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114457.png)
